issues.description: The required Signatures_Firm_Names_Merged4.csv is explicitly created by hand from fuzzy firm-match candidates and imported by the do-file. The code itself supplies high-score firm exclusions, hard-coded GVKEY corrections and multiple-GVKEY exclusions, as well as specific executive/co_per_rol exclusions; it also states that checking unmatched executive candidates found no additional matches. The remaining gap is the missing Merged4.csv and clarification of whether any additional firm decisions beyond the encoded decisions were used.
crsppermnolink.dta is read directly and reduced to one row per PERMNO, but no code or specification produces it. The relation to generated CCM_Link1.dta and the row-selection rule are unknown.

crspreturns.dta is read directly with CUSIP, date, ret and ewretd fields, but no code builds it. Local stock-return and market-index candidates are separate products; the authors’ exact extraction/merge is not supplied.

internalcontrols.dta, auditfees.dta and restatements.dta are direct inputs with no in-file producer; local Audit Analytics candidates use COMPANY_FKEY/source-specific fields and require an undocumented mapping to CIK/fyear and the author input schema.

The local CCM candidate lacks CONM and CONML, but HLSW_Code.do line 28 keeps those variables. They are not used downstream in the supplied code; using this candidate requires author confirmation or a narrowly scoped edit to drop the unused fields.

The code sorts restatement data by CIK only, then uses row offsets 1–10 for later restatement intervals. The intended within-CIK order is not defined, so a deterministic date ordering cannot be assumed.

The code defines salesgrowth with revt[_n-3] after merging firm-year data but does not group/xtset by GVKEY in this block. The intended three-year within-firm comparison or other ordering must be confirmed before changing the formula.

The current author route identifies the delta/vega product fields and period, but the delivered file format/header has not been inspected. The do-file uses insheet on deltavega.csv without the names option, so compatibility requires checking the actual file header/import semantics.

All code input/output names are relative and the do-file does not set a working directory; execution must start in a prepared folder containing the input files or Stata will resolve names against the wrong directory.

review_notes: Generation_004 is a targeted same-paper revision of the accepted pair. The sole assessment-text correction is that the experimental-data validation now treats Stata literal variable names as case-sensitive; the target scope, outcomes and supported uncertainties are otherwise preserved.

Same-paper probes referenced by the carried-forward evidence were copied byte-for-byte into this generation's probes, with source/destination hashes recorded in probes/prior_metadata_provenance.json; the current environment artifact hash was verified.
All 35 frozen dependency IDs are reviewed individually. Generated Compustat intermediate files in the j=1..10 loops are manually traced; no generated file is treated as an independent source.

The package has one full_pipeline scope only. No author-prepared final analysis dataset supports a separate analysis_only scope. The final experimental section is included because the datasheet documents it and the do-file contains its four regressions.

Local probes read one row only and do not establish dataset period, full history, entitlement or the exact author snapshot. Commercial-source catalog entries and local paths are candidates, not inferred licenses.

Open workflow gaps are specifically identified: missing manual correction and raw inputs; no in-file producer for crsppermnolink.dta, crspreturns.dta and Audit Analytics prepared inputs; unresolved row ordering/formula questions; input-format uncertainty for the current Delta/Vega author route.
No author code was edited or executed; no regressions, installations, data downloads, outgoing messages, or publishing/review actions were performed.
